cap: Cholesterol is built into testosterone by CYP enzymes, converted by 5-alpha-reductase to DHT, and either hormone acts through the androgen receptor. Ketoconazole blocks synthesis, finasteride and dutasteride block 5-alpha-reductase, and flutamide, bicalutamide, enzalutamide, cyproterone and spironolactone block the receptor; spironolactone also lowers synthesis. Aromatase turns testosterone into estradiol, so a rising estrogen-to-androgen ratio causes gynecomastia.
teach: Gynecomastia is normal in newborns, puberty and old age. It is pathologic in Klinefelter syndrome, cirrhosis, testicular tumors that secrete hCG or estrogen, hyperthyroidism and obesity, and with anabolic steroids through aromatization. Antiandrogen therapy for prostate cancer adds hot flashes, lost libido and erections, fatigue and bone loss.
